text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's sunset and Manhattan Cafe and I are taking a stroll through town, making sure to avoid the evening sun, when…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Look… Ahead of us… there's a big crowd…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Don't let this opportunity pass you by! Why don't you give it a go? Yes, you, the trainer in the back!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: A raffle…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Whoa, I didn't see your buddy there! Y-you're more than welcome to join the fun too, little lady…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I glance at my right hand to see that I'm already holding a raffle ticket. I don't remember taking one, though…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um… Why don't we give it a try? This is probably some sort of sign…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Convinced, we grab the lever together. The raffle tumbler spins, whirring like the cogs of destiny!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the tumbler's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: We won… the hot spring coupon!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The hot springs… First you trek to an inn deep in the mountains, where you take a long, warm soak in the spring waters… And then you…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Just go to bed?
choice_data_list: Well, you could also have a nice chat or a good meal.
Well, you could also have a nice chat or a good meal.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: That's… true. You could do those things as long as you had company.
choice_data_list: You should go with your friend.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …With my friend?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But she wouldn't need a ticket. What are you…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I find myself the subject of a baffled look. I decide to go ahead and pass the ticket to her, when…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It vanishes right out of my hand! Where the heck did it go?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank you… very much. It's kind of you to hold onto the ticket for me. Let's go when our schedule opens up.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Make sure you don't lose it in the meantime. Although, even if you do… I'm sure it'll find its way back into your pocket.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next moment, the vacation ticket is snug in my pocket. I'd better keep this lucky ticket safe and sound.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The deluxe carrot hamburger steak… This is a pretty good prize…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Look. The carrot's sticking out of the hamburger steak.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it's rather cute. It's almost like…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: A gravestone on a hilltop. A forgotten grave… that no one visits.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Let's imagine it as we eat. What type of person could it be, resting eternally below the ground?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her statements might be a little… detached from reality, but Manhattan Cafe looks happy. We enjoy the hamburger steak together.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Carrots… And there are quite a lot of them. I'm happy to win all of these, but…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I don't think my stomach can handle this many. Could we save these carrots until tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Well, sometimes when you wait a day, a few of them disappear, don't they? If some of them vanish, I think we could comfortably finish off whatever's left.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Did I say something strange?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We wait and eat the carrots the following day. I lack the courage to count them before we dig in.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: A carrot… A single carrot.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But perhaps we should be grateful. This actually reminds me of a certain fable…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: There once was a single carrot. Just the one. But the townspeople planted it in the ground, and hoped for the best. And then, miraculously…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Its roots stretched out and spread underneath the entire town. And before long, carrots were cropping up everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The townspeople were delighted. However, there were so many carrots that no matter how many they ate, they could never finish them…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Eventually, an orange forest consumed the town, and the carrots formed a spire that rose into the sky, and…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Well, about that carrot… should we plant it when we get back? Or should we just eat it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We split the carrot and wolf it down in a hurry. It isn't especially filling, but I feel an immense sense of relief.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: A pack of tissues…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Shall we burn them?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Shall we bring them to life and make them move around?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Oh, okay. So they can just be tissues, then.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: To be used… and thrown away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A vague shadow descends over Manhattan Cafe's face. Is she… disappointed?
